# Public NOAA metadata regression

`real-metadata.xml` contains the series element and US5CA1LK metadata element
extracted from NOAA's public ISO19115 catalogue, fetched 2026-10-16:
https://charts.noaa.gov/ENCs/ENCProdCat_19115.xml.
The complete original was 52,363,347 bytes, SHA256
`61509e0c72439cbbf30e4dab12c1f223ad40cdf321cd564762734af3d38c0588`.
XML namespace serialization changes the excerpt bytes; element values are kept.
It contains public chart metadata, without boat, account or licensed chart data.

The provider's series DateTime is literally `ENC Product Catalog`; each real
cell's metadata issuance is `2026-10-16T04:59:07Z`. This exact known series
placeholder is unavailable as a date. Unknown malformed date fields fail closed.

`generated-index.json` is generated by `scripts/noaa-enc/catalogue.py` from that
excerpt, with no converted objects and a fixed separate check time
`2026-10-16T06:00:00Z`. The Python regression requires exact parsed-object
equality with its generated result, including immutable shard hashes and source
identity. The TypeScript regression passes that same generated object to the
actual phone contract. Changes require regenerating the fixture and retaining
the distinction between source issuance and check time.

`generated-revisions.json.txt` retains the exact compact, newline-terminated
metadata-only revision cohort generated with that index. The `.txt` suffix
prevents JSON formatting from altering the hashed wire bytes. The Python and
TypeScript regressions require exact bytes, generation, length and SHA256. This
is public NOAA metadata, with no chart geometry or private boat data. Existing
published generations without the optional revisions object remain valid but
cannot claim a complete edition check.
